Garage description
A regular, non-animated paint that serves as an aesthetic coating for your tank. Its color scheme might potentially offer some camouflage benefits, but besides that, the paint does not offer any functional gameplay advantages.
See also: Paints
Interesting facts
The paint appeared on November 1st, 2020.
The paint could have been obtained by completing a special mission "Attack on the Dead. Day 2" from the "Attack on the Dead" event, which was to kill the player wearing the Dead paint in DM matchmaking battles within 12 hrs.
